summary: Alps Group Inc filed a Form 6-K on May 19, 2026, disclosing receipt of a Nasdaq deficiency notice for failing to maintain a minimum $1.00 bid price per share for 30 consecutive business days. The company has a 180-day cure period until November 11, 2026, and may qualify for an additional 180 days if it meets other listing standards. The company is evaluating options, including a reverse stock split, to regain compliance. This is a routine listing compliance disclosure, not a special situation event. There are no deal terms, premiums, or structural changes involved. What to watch: potential reverse stock split or eventual delisting if compliance is not regained.
